up: List all distinct molecules reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5726376. For each molecule, return its ChEMBL ID (chembl_id), preferred name (pref_name), and molecule type (molecule_type).
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.molecule_type FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5726376';
